025/** Global registry for tunable handlers and tunable backends. */
026public final class TunableRegistry {
027  /**
028   * Handler for tuning objects of specific type. Typically only one handler is specified.
029   *
030   * @param <T> object type
031   */
032  @FunctionalInterface
033  public interface TypeHandler<T> {
034    /**
035     * Create tunable.
036     *
037     * @param initialValue initial value
038     * @param config tunable configuration
039     * @return tunable
040     */
041    Tunable<T> createTunable(T initialValue, TunableConfig config);

050  private record TypeHandlerData<T>(Class<T> cls, TypeHandler<T> handler) {}

052  private record ComplexMigrationRecorder(
053      Set<String> publishedPaths, ComplexMigrationRecorder previous) {}

055  private record RevisionParentLink(Object child, ComplexTunable parent) {}

057  private record RevisionParentLinkState(String path, RevisionParentLink link) {}

065  private record ComplexChildPathState(String path, TunableBase previousTunable) {}

067  private static final class WeakIdentityKey extends WeakReference<Object> {
068    private final int m_hash;
069
070    WeakIdentityKey(Object value, ReferenceQueue<Object> queue) {
071      super(Objects.requireNonNull(value), queue);
072      m_hash = System.identityHashCode(value);
073    }
074
075    WeakIdentityKey(Object value) {
076      super(Objects.requireNonNull(value));
077      m_hash = System.identityHashCode(value);
078    }
079
080    @Override
081    public int hashCode() {
082      return m_hash;
083    }
084
085    @Override
086    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
087      return this == obj
088          || obj instanceof WeakIdentityKey other && get() != null && get() == other.get();
089    }
090  }
091
092  private static final class WeakIdentityMap<K, V> {
093    private final ReferenceQueue<Object> m_queue = new ReferenceQueue<>();
094    private final Map<WeakIdentityKey, V> m_values = new HashMap<>();
095
096    private void cleanStaleEntries() {
097      WeakIdentityKey key;
098      while ((key = (WeakIdentityKey) m_queue.poll()) != null) {
099        m_values.remove(key);
100      }
101    }
102
103    V get(K key) {
104      cleanStaleEntries();
105      return m_values.get(new WeakIdentityKey(key));
106    }
107
108    V getOrDefault(K key, V defaultValue) {
109      V value = get(key);
110      return value != null ? value : defaultValue;
111    }
112
113    void put(K key, V value) {
114      cleanStaleEntries();
115      m_values.put(new WeakIdentityKey(key, m_queue), value);
116    }
117
118    void remove(K key) {
119      cleanStaleEntries();
120      m_values.remove(new WeakIdentityKey(key));
121    }
122
123    void clear() {
124      m_values.clear();
125      cleanStaleEntries();
126    }
127
128    boolean isEmpty() {
129      cleanStaleEntries();
130      return m_values.isEmpty();
131    }
132
133    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
134    List<K> keySnapshot() {
135      cleanStaleEntries();
136      List<K> keys = new ArrayList<>();
137      var iterator = m_values.keySet().iterator();
138      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
139        Object key = iterator.next().get();
140        if (key == null) {
141          iterator.remove();
142        } else {
143          keys.add((K) key);
144        }
145      }
146      return keys;
147    }
148  }

205  private static void defaultReportWarning(String msg) {
206    // TODO: do something smarter here
207    StackTraceElement[] stackTrace = Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace();
208    StringBuilder traceString = new StringBuilder();
209    for (int i = 1; i < stackTrace.length; i++) {
210      String loc = stackTrace[i].toString();
211      traceString.append("\tat ").append(loc).append('\n');
212    }
213
214    System.err.println("Tunable warning: " + msg + "\n" + traceString.toString());
215  }

217  /**
218   * Set function used for reporting warning messages (e.g. type mismatches).
219   *
220   * <p>The reporting function must not throw.
221   *
222   * @param func reporting function; pass null to use default
223   */
224  public static void setReportWarning(Consumer<String> func) {
225    synchronized (TunableRegistry.class) {
226      if (func == null) {
227        s_reportWarning = TunableRegistry::defaultReportWarning;
228      } else {
229        s_reportWarning = func;
230      }
231    }
232  }
233
234  /**
235   * Get function used for reporting warning messages.
236   *
237   * @return reporting function
238   */
239  public static Consumer<String> getReportWarning() {
240    synchronized (TunableRegistry.class) {
241      return s_reportWarning;
242    }
243  }

245  /**
246   * Report a warning message (e.g. type mismatch).
247   *
248   * @param msg warning message
249   */
250  public static void reportWarning(String msg) {
251    synchronized (TunableRegistry.class) {
252      s_reportWarning.accept(msg);
253    }
254  }

256  /**
257   * Registers a handler for tuning objects of a particular type. The handler should populate the
258   * provided TunableTable name as appropriate for the object's data.
259   *
260   * @param <T> class
261   * @param cls class object
262   * @param handler handler (accepts TunableTable, entry name, and object)
263   */
264  public static <T> void registerTypeHandler(Class<T> cls, TypeHandler<T> handler) {
265    synchronized (s_typeHandlers) {
266      // we want this ordered such that the more specific types come before the less specific ones
267      // this is O(N^2) but N should be small
268      boolean replace = false;
269      int i = 0;
270      for (var entry : s_typeHandlers) {
271        if (entry.cls.equals(cls)) {
272          // replace existing
273          replace = true;
274          break;
275        }
276        if (entry.cls.isAssignableFrom(cls)) {
277          // superclass; insert before
278          break;
279        }
280        i++;
281      }
282
283      if (replace) {
284        s_typeHandlers.set(i, new TypeHandlerData<>(cls, handler));
285      } else {
286        s_typeHandlers.add(i, new TypeHandlerData<>(cls, handler));
287      }
288    }
289  }
290
291  /**
292   * Registers a backend for creating tunables. When calling getBackend(), the longest prefix match
293   * is used.
294   *
295   * @param prefix prefix for tunables covered by this backend
296   * @param backend backend
297   */
298  @SuppressWarnings({"PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals", "PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException"})
299  public static void registerBackend(String prefix, TunableBackend backend) {
300    String normalizedPrefix = PathUtil.normalizeBackendPrefix(prefix);
301    List<TunableBackend> closeBackends = new ArrayList<>();
302    synchronized (s_backends) {
303      final List<TunableBackend> oldBackends = new ArrayList<>(s_backends.values());
304      s_backends.remove(normalizedPrefix);
305      s_backends.put(normalizedPrefix, backend);
306      updateBackendSnapshot();
307
308      List<TunableBackend.PublishedTunable> migrations = new ArrayList<>();
309      IdentityHashMap<TunableBackend, Boolean> displacedBackends = new IdentityHashMap<>();
310      for (TunableBackend oldBackend : oldBackends) {
311        if (oldBackend != backend) {
312          migrations.addAll(oldBackend.removePrefix(normalizedPrefix));
313          displacedBackends.put(oldBackend, Boolean.TRUE);
314        }
315      }
316
317      // Java complex backends publish the parent and then publish their child entries as a side
318      // effect of publishComplex(). Republish complex entries first and record the paths they
319      // actually recreate so only those returned entries are suppressed.
320      Set<String> publishedComplexChildren = new HashSet<>();
321      List<TunableBackend.PublishedTunable> complexMigrations = new ArrayList<>();
322      for (var published : migrations) {
323        if (published.isComplex()) {
324          complexMigrations.add(published);
325        }
326      }
327      complexMigrations.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(a.path().length(), b.path().length()));
328
329      for (var published : complexMigrations) {
330        if (publishedComplexChildren.contains(published.path())) {
331          continue;
332        }
333        TunableBackend targetBackend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(published.path());
334        publishMigratedComplex(targetBackend, published, publishedComplexChildren);
335      }
336
337      for (var published : migrations) {
338        if (published.isComplex() || publishedComplexChildren.contains(published.path())) {
339          continue;
340        }
341        TunableBackend targetBackend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(published.path());
342        targetBackend.publish(published.path(), published.tunable());
343      }
344
345      IdentityHashMap<TunableBackend, Boolean> currentBackends = new IdentityHashMap<>();
346      for (TunableBackend currentBackend : s_backendSnapshot) {
347        currentBackends.put(currentBackend, Boolean.TRUE);
348      }
349      for (TunableBackend displacedBackend : displacedBackends.keySet()) {
350        if (!currentBackends.containsKey(displacedBackend)) {
351          closeBackends.add(displacedBackend);
352        }
353      }
354    }
355
356    for (TunableBackend closeBackend : closeBackends) {
357      try {
358        closeBackend.close();
359      } catch (Exception e) {
360        System.out.println("Unexpected exception when closing backend: " + e);
361      }
362    }
363  }
364
365  private static void publishMigratedComplex(
366      TunableBackend targetBackend,
367      TunableBackend.PublishedTunable published,
368      Set<String> publishedComplexChildren) {
369    ComplexMigrationRecorder previous = s_complexMigrationRecorder.get();
370    s_complexMigrationRecorder.set(
371        new ComplexMigrationRecorder(publishedComplexChildren, previous));
372    try {
373      targetBackend.publishComplex(published.path(), published.complex());
374    } finally {
375      if (previous == null) {
376        s_complexMigrationRecorder.remove();
377      } else {
378        s_complexMigrationRecorder.set(previous);
379      }
380    }
381  }
382
383  private static void recordComplexMigrationPublish(String path) {
384    ComplexMigrationRecorder recorder = s_complexMigrationRecorder.get();
385    while (recorder != null) {
386      recorder.publishedPaths().add(path);
387      recorder = recorder.previous();
388    }
389  }
390
391  private static void updateBackendSnapshot() {
392    IdentityHashMap<TunableBackend, Boolean> uniqueBackends = new IdentityHashMap<>();
393    List<TunableBackend> snapshot = new ArrayList<>();
394    for (TunableBackend backend : s_backends.values()) {
395      if (uniqueBackends.put(backend, Boolean.TRUE) == null) {
396        snapshot.add(backend);
397      }
398    }
399    s_backendSnapshot = snapshot.toArray(new TunableBackend[0]);
400  }

402  /**
403   * Gets the handler for logging an object. Should generally only be used by Tunable.
404   *
405   * @param <T> class
406   * @param value value
407   * @return handler or null if no match
408   */
409  public static <T> TypeHandler<T> getTypeHandler(T value) {
410    synchronized (s_typeHandlers) {
411      for (var entry : s_typeHandlers) {
412        if (entry.cls.isInstance(value)) {
413          @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
414          TypeHandler<T> handler = (TypeHandler<T>) entry.handler;
415          return handler;
416        }
417      }
418      return null;
419    }
420  }

422  /**
423   * Gets the backend for creating a tunable. Should generally only be used internally or by custom
424   * backends.
425   *
426   * @param path full name
427   * @return tunable backend, or a no-op backend if no match
428   */
429  public static TunableBackend getBackend(String path) {
430    String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
431    TunableBackend backend;
432    synchronized (s_backends) {
433      backend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(normalized);
434    }
435    if (isMissingBackend(backend)) {
436      reportWarning("no backend for path '" + normalized + "'");
437    }
438    return backend;
439  }
440
441  private static TunableBackend getBackendForNormalizedPath(String path) {
442    String candidate = path;
443    while (true) {
444      TunableBackend backend = s_backends.get(candidate);
445      if (backend != null) {
446        return backend;
447      }
448
449      int slash = candidate.lastIndexOf('/');
450      if (slash <= 0) {
451        break;
452      }
453      candidate = candidate.substring(0, slash);
454    }
455
456    TunableBackend rootBackend = s_backends.get("/");
457    if (rootBackend != null) {
458      return rootBackend;
459    }
460    TunableBackend defaultBackend = s_backends.get("");
461    if (defaultBackend != null) {
462      return defaultBackend;
463    }
464    return s_missingBackend;
465  }
466
467  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
468  private static boolean isMissingBackend(TunableBackend backend) {
469    return backend == s_missingBackend;
470  }
471
472  static void notifyChanged(TunableBase tunable) {
473    for (TunableBackend backend : s_backendSnapshot) {
474      backend.markDirty(tunable);
475    }
476  }

478  /**
479   * Returns a tunable's current tuning revision token.
480   *
481   * <p>The token starts at zero and changes once for each tuning input that a backend successfully
482   * applies to this tunable or one of its descendant tunables. Direct local {@code set()} calls,
483   * in-place mutations, and getter refreshes do not change it. Reading the token does not consume
484   * or reset it, so independent observers can each store a previous token and compare it to the
485   * current value with {@code !=}.
486   *
487   * <p>Treat this as a 64-bit equality token. Do not rely on ordering or sign. This getter follows
488   * the same threading model as the rest of the tunable API and does not make tunable access
489   * thread-safe.
490   *
491   * @param tunable tunable
492   * @return current tuning revision token
493   */
494  public static long getTuneRevision(TunableBase tunable) {
495    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
496      return s_tuneRevisions.getOrDefault(getRevisionOwner(tunable), 0L);
497    }
498  }
499
500  /**
501   * Returns a complex tunable's current tuning revision token.
502   *
503   * <p>This is the same token returned for the underlying registry record, and it also advances
504   * when a backend successfully applies tuning input to a descendant child tunable.
505   *
506   * @param tunable complex tunable
507   * @return current tuning revision token
508   */
509  public static long getTuneRevision(ComplexTunable tunable) {
510    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
511      return s_tuneRevisions.getOrDefault(tunable, 0L);
512    }
513  }
514
515  /**
516   * Records that a backend successfully applied one tuning input to a tunable.
517   *
518   * <p>{@link TunableBackend} implementations should call this exactly once after each accepted
519   * remote tuning input has been applied to the tunable value, before scheduling any corresponding
520   * {@code onTune} callback. Rejected inputs and writes ignored due to immutability should not call
521   * this method.
522   *
523   * @param tunable tuned tunable
524   */
525  public static void recordTuneApplied(TunableBase tunable) {
526    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
527      incrementTuneRevision(getRevisionOwner(tunable), new IdentityHashMap<>());
528    }
529  }
530
531  /**
532   * Resets a tunable's changed flag after the current update cycle finishes.
533   *
534   * <p>Backends should call this after publishing a changed tunable so every alias in every backend
535   * can observe the shared changed flag before it is cleared.
536   *
537   * @param tunable tunable to reset
538   */
539  public static void resetChangedAfterUpdate(TunableBase tunable) {
540    synchronized (s_backends) {
541      if (s_updateDepth > 0) {
542        s_pendingChangedResets.put(tunable, Boolean.TRUE);
543      } else {
544        tunable.resetChanged();
545      }
546    }
547  }
548
549  /**
550   * Runs a callback after the current update cycle finishes resetting changed flags.
551   *
552   * <p>Backends should use this for callbacks that react to tuned values so callback mutations are
553   * observed as new changes in the next update cycle.
554   *
555   * @param callback callback to run; must not throw
556   */
557  public static void runAfterUpdate(Runnable callback) {
558    synchronized (s_backends) {
559      if (s_updateDepth > 0) {
560        s_pendingUpdateCallbacks.add(callback);
561      } else {
562        callback.run();
563      }
564    }
565  }
566
567  /**
568   * Updates a complex tunable if it has not already been updated during the current registry
569   * update.
570   *
571   * <p>This should generally only be used by {@link TunableBackend} implementations.
572   *
573   * @param tunable tunable to update
574   */
575  public static void updateComplexIfNeeded(ComplexTunable tunable) {
576    synchronized (s_backends) {
577      if (s_updateDepth > 0 && s_updatedComplexTunables.put(tunable, Boolean.TRUE) != null) {
578        return;
579      }
580      tunable.updateTunable();
581    }
582  }
583
584  private static void finishUpdate() {
585    s_updateDepth--;
586    if (s_updateDepth != 0) {
587      return;
588    }
589
590    s_updatedComplexTunables.clear();
591
592    if (!s_pendingChangedResets.isEmpty()) {
593      for (TunableBase tunable : s_pendingChangedResets.keySet()) {
594        tunable.resetChanged();
595      }
596      s_pendingChangedResets.clear();
597    }
598
599    if (s_pendingUpdateCallbacks.isEmpty()) {
600      return;
601    }
602
603    List<Runnable> callbacks = new ArrayList<>(s_pendingUpdateCallbacks);
604    s_pendingUpdateCallbacks.clear();
605    for (Runnable callback : callbacks) {
606      callback.run();
607    }
608  }

620  /**
621   * Publishes a complex tunable's children.

623   * <p>This should generally only be used by {@link TunableBackend} implementations after they
624   * publish the complex parent entry.
625   *
626   * @param path normalized path

629  public static void publishComplexChildren(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
630    tunable.publishTunable(getTable(path));
631  }
632
633  /**
634   * Publishes a tunable.
635   *
636   * @param path normalized path
637   * @param tunable the tunable
638   * @return true if the backend accepted the tunable
639   */
640  public static boolean publish(String path, TunableBase tunable) {
641    if (tunable instanceof Tunable.CustomTunable t) {
642      return publish(path, t.getInnerTunable());
643    }
644    String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
645    boolean missingBackend = false;
646    synchronized (s_backends) {
647      TunableBackend backend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(normalized);
648      if (isMissingBackend(backend)) {
649        missingBackend = true;
650      } else {
651        ComplexChildPathState childPathState = addComplexChildPath(normalized, tunable);
652        if (backend.publish(path, tunable)) {
653          recordComplexMigrationPublish(normalized);
654          return true;
655        }
656        restoreComplexChildPath(childPathState);
657      }
658    }
659    if (missingBackend) {
660      reportWarning("no backend for path '" + normalized + "'");
661    }
662    return false;
663  }
664
665  /**
666   * Publishes a complex tunable.
667   *
668   * @param path normalized path
669   * @param tunable the tunable
670   * @return true if the backend accepted the tunable
671   */
672  public static boolean publish(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
673    String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
674    boolean missingBackend = false;
675    synchronized (s_backends) {
676      TunableBackend backend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(normalized);
677      if (isMissingBackend(backend)) {
678        missingBackend = true;
679      } else {
680        ComplexPathState pathState = addComplexPath(normalized, tunable);
681        if (backend.publishComplex(path, tunable)) {
682          recordComplexMigrationPublish(normalized);
683          return true;
684        } else if (pathState.addedPath()) {
685          restoreComplexPath(pathState);
686        }
687      }
688    }
689    if (missingBackend) {
690      reportWarning("no backend for path '" + normalized + "'");
691    }
692    return false;
693  }

695  /**
696   * Publishes a child tunable under every currently published path for a complex tunable.
697   *
698   * @param parent the parent complex tunable
699   * @param name the child name
700   * @param tunable the child tunable
701   */
702  static void publishChild(ComplexTunable parent, String name, TunableBase tunable) {
703    for (String path : getComplexPaths(parent)) {
704      publish(PathUtil.normalizeName(path + "/" + name), tunable);
705    }
706  }

708  /**
709   * Publishes a child complex tunable under every currently published path for a complex tunable.
710   *
711   * @param parent the parent complex tunable
712   * @param name the child name
713   * @param tunable the child complex tunable
714   */
715  static void publishChild(ComplexTunable parent, String name, ComplexTunable tunable) {
716    for (String path : getComplexPaths(parent)) {
717      publish(PathUtil.normalizeName(path + "/" + name), tunable);
718    }
719  }

721  /**
722   * Removes a child tunable from every currently published path for a complex tunable.
723   *
724   * @param parent the parent complex tunable
725   * @param name the child name
726   */
727  static void removeChild(ComplexTunable parent, String name) {
728    for (String path : getComplexPaths(parent)) {
729      remove(PathUtil.normalizeName(path + "/" + name));
730    }
731  }
732
733  /**
734   * Marks a child tunable as locally changed.
735   *
736   * @param parent the parent complex tunable
737   * @param name the child name
738   */
739  static void setChildChanged(ComplexTunable parent, String name) {
740    List<TunableBase> children = new ArrayList<>();
741    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
742      List<String> paths = s_complexPaths.get(parent);
743      if (paths == null) {
744        return;
745      }
746      for (String path : paths) {
747        TunableBase child = s_complexChildrenByPath.get(PathUtil.normalizeName(path + "/" + name));
748        if (child != null && !children.contains(child)) {
749          children.add(child);
750        }
751      }
752    }
753    for (TunableBase child : children) {
754      child.markChanged();
755    }
756  }
757
758  /**
759   * Removes a tunable.
760   *
761   * @param path normalized path
762   */
763  public static void remove(String path) {
764    // Backends may have changed since publishing, so remove from all backends
765    synchronized (s_backends) {
766      String childPrefix = PathUtil.childTablePath(path);
767      for (var entry : s_backends.values()) {
768        entry.remove(path);
769        entry.removePrefix(childPrefix);
770      }
771    }
772    removeComplexChildPaths(path);
773    removeComplexPaths(path);
774  }
775
776  /**
777   * Removes every tracked publication for a complex tunable.
778   *
779   * @param tunable complex tunable to remove
780   */
781  public static void remove(ComplexTunable tunable) {
782    for (String path : getComplexPaths(tunable)) {
783      remove(path);
784    }
785  }
786
787  /** Updates all tunable values from backends. */
788  public static void update() {
789    synchronized (s_backends) {
790      s_updateDepth++;
791      for (TunableBackend entry : s_backendSnapshot) {
792        entry.update();
793      }
794      finishUpdate();
795    }
796  }
797
798  /**
799   * Execute a function while holding the same mutex used for update(). As tunables are not
800   * thread-safe, this is designed to allow external synchronization for tunables used in secondary
801   * threads outside of the robot main loop.
802   *
803   * <p>Every competing access, including main-loop access, must use this method or another safe
804   * handoff. The update mutex is held while backends and user callbacks run, so the function should
805   * be short and must not allow a mutable tunable value to escape and be accessed after the
806   * function completes.
807   *
808   * @param func function to execute
809   */
810  public static void withUpdateMutex(Runnable func) {
811    synchronized (s_backends) {
812      func.run();
813    }
814  }
815
816  /**
817   * Clear all registered types and backends and closes all entries. Should typically only be used
818   * by unit test code.
819   */
820  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
821  public static void reset() {
822    List<TunableBackend> backends = new ArrayList<>();
823    synchronized (s_typeHandlers) {
824      s_typeHandlers.clear();
825    }
826    synchronized (s_backends) {
827      backends.addAll(Arrays.asList(s_backendSnapshot));
828      s_backends.clear();
829      updateBackendSnapshot();
830      s_pendingChangedResets.clear();
831      s_updatedComplexTunables.clear();
832      s_pendingUpdateCallbacks.clear();
833      s_updateDepth = 0;
834    }
835    for (TunableBackend backend : backends) {
836      backend.removePrefix("");
837      try {
838        backend.close();
839      } catch (Exception e) {
840        System.out.println("Unexpected exception when closing backend: " + e);
841      }
842    }
843    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
844      s_complexPaths.clear();
845      s_complexByPath.clear();
846      s_complexChildrenByPath.clear();
847      s_tuneRevisions.clear();
848      s_revisionParents.clear();
849      s_revisionParentLinksByPath.clear();
850    }
851  }
852
853  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
854  private static TunableBase getRevisionOwner(TunableBase tunable) {
855    if (tunable instanceof Tunable.CustomTunable custom) {
856      TunableBase inner = custom.getInnerTunable();
857      if (inner != null && inner != tunable) {
858        return getRevisionOwner(inner);
859      }
860    }
861    return tunable;
862  }
863
864  private static void incrementTuneRevision(
865      Object tunable, IdentityHashMap<Object, Boolean> visited) {
866    if (visited.put(tunable, Boolean.TRUE) != null) {
867      return;
868    }
869    s_tuneRevisions.put(tunable, s_tuneRevisions.getOrDefault(tunable, 0L) + 1L);
870    WeakIdentityMap<ComplexTunable, Integer> parents = s_revisionParents.get(tunable);
871    if (parents == null) {
872      return;
873    }
874    for (ComplexTunable parent : parents.keySnapshot()) {
875      incrementTuneRevision(parent, visited);
876    }
877  }
878
879  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
880  private static ComplexTunable findNearestComplexParent(String path, Object child) {
881    String bestPrefix = null;
882    ComplexTunable bestParent = null;
883    for (var entry : s_complexByPath.entrySet()) {
884      ComplexTunable parent = entry.getValue();
885      if (parent == child) {
886        continue;
887      }
888      String childPrefix = PathUtil.childTablePath(entry.getKey());
889      if (path.startsWith(childPrefix)
890          && (bestPrefix == null || childPrefix.length() > bestPrefix.length())) {
891        bestPrefix = childPrefix;
892        bestParent = parent;
893      }
894    }
895    return bestParent;
896  }
897
898  private static void addRevisionParent(Object child, ComplexTunable parent) {
899    WeakIdentityMap<ComplexTunable, Integer> parents = s_revisionParents.get(child);
900    if (parents == null) {
901      parents = new WeakIdentityMap<>();
902      s_revisionParents.put(child, parents);
903    }
904    Integer count = parents.get(parent);
905    parents.put(parent, count == null ? 1 : count + 1);
906  }
907
908  private static void removeRevisionParent(Object child, ComplexTunable parent) {
909    WeakIdentityMap<ComplexTunable, Integer> parents = s_revisionParents.get(child);
910    if (parents == null) {
911      return;
912    }
913    Integer count = parents.get(parent);
914    if (count == null) {
915      return;
916    } else if (count > 1) {
917      parents.put(parent, count - 1);
918    } else {
919      parents.remove(parent);
920      if (parents.isEmpty()) {
921        s_revisionParents.remove(child);
922      }
923    }
924  }
925
926  private static void addRevisionParentLink(String path, Object child, ComplexTunable parent) {
927    RevisionParentLink oldLink =
928        s_revisionParentLinksByPath.put(path, new RevisionParentLink(child, parent));
929    if (oldLink != null) {
930      removeRevisionParent(oldLink.child(), oldLink.parent());
931    }
932    if (parent == null) {
933      s_revisionParentLinksByPath.remove(path);
934      return;
935    }
936    addRevisionParent(child, parent);
937  }
938
939  private static void linkRevisionParentForPath(String path, Object child) {
940    addRevisionParentLink(path, child, findNearestComplexParent(path, child));
941  }
942
943  private static void removeRevisionParentLink(String path) {
944    RevisionParentLink link = s_revisionParentLinksByPath.remove(path);
945    if (link != null) {
946      removeRevisionParent(link.child(), link.parent());
947    }
948  }
949
950  private static void restoreRevisionParentLinks(List<RevisionParentLinkState> states) {
951    for (int i = states.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
952      RevisionParentLinkState state = states.get(i);
953      removeRevisionParentLink(state.path());
954      if (state.link() != null) {
955        s_revisionParentLinksByPath.put(state.path(), state.link());
956        addRevisionParent(state.link().child(), state.link().parent());
957      }
958    }
959  }
960
961  private static List<RevisionParentLinkState> linkExistingComplexDescendants(String path) {
962    List<RevisionParentLinkState> previousLinks = new ArrayList<>();
963    String childPrefix = PathUtil.childTablePath(path);
964    for (var entry : s_complexChildrenByPath.entrySet()) {
965      if (entry.getKey().startsWith(childPrefix)) {
966        previousLinks.add(
967            new RevisionParentLinkState(
968                entry.getKey(), s_revisionParentLinksByPath.get(entry.getKey())));
969        linkRevisionParentForPath(entry.getKey(), getRevisionOwner(entry.getValue()));
970      }
971    }
972    for (var entry : s_complexByPath.entrySet()) {
973      if (!entry.getKey().equals(path) && entry.getKey().startsWith(childPrefix)) {
974        previousLinks.add(
975            new RevisionParentLinkState(
976                entry.getKey(), s_revisionParentLinksByPath.get(entry.getKey())));
977        linkRevisionParentForPath(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
978      }
979    }
980    return previousLinks;
981  }
982
983  private static ComplexChildPathState addComplexChildPath(String path, TunableBase tunable) {
984    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
985      String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
986      TunableBase previousTunable = s_complexChildrenByPath.put(normalized, tunable);
987      if (previousTunable != null) {
988        removeRevisionParentLink(normalized);
989      }
990      linkRevisionParentForPath(normalized, getRevisionOwner(tunable));
991      return new ComplexChildPathState(normalized, previousTunable);
992    }
993  }
994
995  private static void restoreComplexChildPath(ComplexChildPathState state) {
996    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
997      removeRevisionParentLink(state.path());
998      if (state.previousTunable() != null) {
999        s_complexChildrenByPath.put(state.path(), state.previousTunable());
1000        linkRevisionParentForPath(state.path(), getRevisionOwner(state.previousTunable()));
1001      } else {
1002        s_complexChildrenByPath.remove(state.path());
1003      }
1004    }
1005  }
1006
1007  private static ComplexPathState addComplexPath(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
1008    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
1009      String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
1010      if (s_complexByPath.containsKey(normalized)) {
1011        return new ComplexPathState(normalized, tunable, false, List.of());
1012      }
1013      linkRevisionParentForPath(normalized, tunable);
1014      s_complexByPath.put(normalized, tunable);
1015      s_complexPaths.computeIfAbsent(tunable, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(normalized);
1016      List<RevisionParentLinkState> descendantLinks = linkExistingComplexDescendants(normalized);
1017      return new ComplexPathState(normalized, tunable, true, descendantLinks);
1018    }
1019  }
1020
1021  private static void restoreComplexPath(ComplexPathState state) {
1022    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
1023      removeComplexPath(state.path(), state.tunable());
1024      restoreRevisionParentLinks(state.descendantLinks());
1025    }
1026  }
1027
1028  private static void removeComplexPaths(String path) {
1029    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
1030      List<String> paths = new ArrayList<>();
1031      for (String complexPath : s_complexByPath.keySet()) {
1032        if (PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(complexPath, path)) {
1033          paths.add(complexPath);
1034        }
1035      }
1036      for (String complexPath : paths) {
1037        ComplexTunable tunable = s_complexByPath.remove(complexPath);
1038        removeRevisionParentLink(complexPath);
1039        removeComplexPath(complexPath, tunable);
1040      }
1041    }
1042  }
1043
1044  private static void removeComplexChildPaths(String path) {
1045    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
1046      List<String> paths = new ArrayList<>();
1047      for (String childPath : s_complexChildrenByPath.keySet()) {
1048        if (PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(childPath, path)) {
1049          paths.add(childPath);
1050        }
1051      }
1052      for (String childPath : paths) {
1053        s_complexChildrenByPath.remove(childPath);
1054        removeRevisionParentLink(childPath);
1055      }
1056    }
1057  }
1058
1059  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
1060  private static void removeComplexPath(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
1061    if (tunable == null) {
1062      return;
1063    }
1064    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
1065      if (s_complexByPath.get(path) == tunable) {
1066        s_complexByPath.remove(path);
1067      }
1068      removeRevisionParentLink(path);
1069      List<String> paths = s_complexPaths.get(tunable);
1070      if (paths == null) {
1071        return;
1072      }
1073      paths.remove(path);
1074      if (paths.isEmpty()) {
1075        s_complexPaths.remove(tunable);
1076      }
1077    }
1078  }
1079
1080  private static List<String> getComplexPaths(ComplexTunable tunable) {
1081    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
1082      List<String> paths = s_complexPaths.get(tunable);
1083      if (paths == null) {
1084        return List.of();
1085      }
1086      return List.copyOf(paths);
1087    }
1088  }
1089}
